description: White canvas; grey rounded quote box top-centre reading 'Q. Since rainbows are caused by the refraction of sunlight by tiny droplets of water, what would a rainbow look like if we had two suns like Tatooine? - Raga'; large stick figure left holding a sheet of paper; empty white rectangular board right. Settled frame.

Single-frame onset: one small sun upper-left of board with a thin ray to a circle (raindrop) right of centre; rainbow-coloured beam leaves the circle toward lower-left. Quote box and figure unchanged.
Board shows one sun upper-left, ray to circular droplet at right, one rainbow-coloured beam running lower-left out of the droplet. Figure and quote box static.
Second small sun appears beside the first; second ray reaches the droplet; second rainbow beam appears lower-left so two beams fan out of the droplet. Suns slightly repositioned.
Board with two small line-drawn suns upper-left, two rays into one droplet circle, two overlapping rainbow beams lower-left. Quote box and figure unchanged.

Board interior changes to flat tan fill with black desert silhouette along bottom (dome building left of centre, tower right, tiny figure); two glowing white suns replace line suns; droplet and ray diagram still overlaid.
Tan board with black desert horizon, two white suns upper-left, droplet/ray drawing still overlaid, rainbow beams at lower-left behind the silhouette.
Droplet circle, rays and beams disappear; only tan sky, two white suns and black silhouette remain.
Tan board: two white suns upper-left, black desert silhouette with dome, tower and tiny figure along bottom. No rainbow.
Two coloured rainbow arcs appear at right of the tan board, rising from behind the silhouette.
Tan board with two white suns, black silhouette, and two rainbow arcs at the right.
Fainter outer arcs appear outside the two bright arcs at right (extra secondary bows), thin and low contrast.
Tan board: two suns, silhouette, bright arcs plus fainter outer arcs at the right; figure and quote box static.

Hard cut at 12.25s to full-frame red title card: black dinosaur on satellite illustration top, white text 'xkcd's what if? THE VIDEO SERIES'. Card holds across sampled frames f294-f332, then a second cut to a white landscape (cloud upper-left, tree with bird left, tiny stick figure, one rainbow arc right). Second cut frame between f332 and f342 UNRESOLVED.
White landscape: outline cloud upper-left, partial cloud upper-right, tree with small bird at far left, tiny stick figure on horizon line, one rainbow arc rising at right. No text.
Grey band and fainter outer arc appear left of the rainbow; black all-caps label 'DOUBLE RAINBOW' appears inside the band at lower centre.
Landscape with rainbow, grey band between faint outer arc and bright arc, label 'DOUBLE RAINBOW' lower centre.
Rotated label 'SECONDARY BOW' appears along the outer-left arc.
Landscape with double rainbow, labels 'DOUBLE RAINBOW' and 'SECONDARY BOW'.
Two more rotated labels appear: 'ALEXANDER'S DARK BAND' (small, inside grey band) and 'PRIMARY BOW' (along bright arc). Scene may be slightly rescaled; not certain.
Landscape with labels 'SECONDARY BOW', 'ALEXANDER'S DARK BAND', 'PRIMARY BOW', 'DOUBLE RAINBOW'.

Asterisk added after 'DOUBLE RAINBOW'; footnote line fades in along bottom edge starting with '*TECHNICALLY, EACH OF YOUR EYES SEES ITS OWN RAINBOW, TOO - DOES THAT MEAN THAT ...' rest unreadable at tile scale.
Landscape with all labels, asterisk, footnote text at bottom; stick figure arms down.
Tiny stick figure raises arms overhead (state swap from arms down). Nothing else changes.
Same landscape and labels; stick figure with raised arms.
Small speech bubble text 'DOUBLE RAINBOW ALL THE WAY!' appears above the figure at left.
Landscape with all labels, footnote, figure with raised arms and caption 'DOUBLE RAINBOW ALL THE WAY!'.

Hard cut to new white scene: line-drawn sun upper-left, two clouds, stick figure centre, horizon line. Next frames add a ray from the sun to a droplet circle labelled '1' at right with coloured arrows and a faint ring below it.
White sky diagram: sun upper-left, ray to droplet circle '1' at right with small coloured arrows, faint rainbow ring below, stick figure centre.
Second droplet circle '2' appears upper right with a ray from the sun and coloured arrows; grey band ring behind droplet 1.
Sun, stick figure, droplet circles '1' and '2' at right with rays and a faint ring.
Third droplet circle '3' appears upper left of figure with ray from the sun; faint ring behind it.
Diagram with droplets '1', '2', '3' and rays from the sun; figure centre.
Fourth droplet circle '4' appears lower left near the figure with a ray from the sun and coloured arrows.
Four numbered droplet circles 1-4 with rays from the sun, coloured arrows, faint rings; figure and clouds unchanged.

Droplet circles and rays disappear; a long thick black line runs from the sun diagonally down-right through the figure; two ring-shaped rainbow cones (faint left, larger right with grey band) shown. Sun, clouds, figure persist.
Thick diagonal line from sun through figure to lower right; faint ring left, larger ring with grey band right; clouds and sun unchanged.
Small rotated label 'FIRST' appears inside the right ring; ring appears slightly larger and cropped at bottom. Exact ring change UNRESOLVED from tile.
Diagram with label 'FIRST' inside right ring; faint ring left.
Rotated label 'SECOND' appears just outside the 'FIRST' ring.
Right ring with labels 'SECOND' and 'FIRST'; faint left ring; thick line through figure.
Rotated label 'THIRD' appears on the faint left ring.
Labels 'THIRD' (left ring), 'SECOND' and 'FIRST' (right ring).
Label 'FOURTH' appears beside 'THIRD' on the left ring.
Labels 'FOURTH', 'THIRD' left; 'SECOND', 'FIRST' right.
Label 'FIFTH' appears near right ring; small stick figure raises one arm (pose changes).
Five ring labels ('FIFTH' 'FOURTH' 'THIRD' 'SECOND' 'FIRST'); stick figure has both arms up.

Hard cut at 38.25s to large stick figure left of a tan panel with black desert silhouette on a ledge; rainbow arcs inside panel are in two groups, then slide toward each other and overlap over the activity frames to 39.83s.
Large stick figure left; tan panel with silhouette; overlapping rainbow arcs right of centre. Encoded-artifact flagged, content mid-drift.
Rainbow arcs in panel continue to shift slightly (low-level drift); no new objects. Exact motion UNRESOLVED at tile scale.
Same panel; arcs further overlapped near right centre; figure unchanged.
Arcs drift again in the panel; small change only. UNRESOLVED fine motion.
Panel with three to four overlapping arcs right of centre; figure unchanged.
Thought bubble appears above-left of the figure containing two small suns, dome building, tower and a tiny figure (Tatooine skyline); arcs in panel shift slightly.
Figure with thought bubble showing two suns and desert skyline; panel with overlapping arcs.
Arcs in panel shift again (drift); thought bubble unchanged.
Thought bubble with two suns and skyline; panel arcs overlapped.
Small arc drift in panel; no other change.
Thought bubble plus panel with overlapping arcs centre-right.
Arcs continue sliding and merge toward right over f1029-f1063; at 44.625s hard cut to white page with heading 'DOUBLE STAR PLANETS' and numerals '1)' and '2)' on left.
White canvas: heading 'DOUBLE STAR PLANETS' top-centre, numerals '1)' upper-left and '2)' lower-left, otherwise empty.
Small line-drawn sun icon appears right of '1)'.
Heading, '1)', '2)', single sun icon beside '1)'.
Sun icon becomes a pair of overlapping suns with a small dashed orbit between them.
Close pair of suns beside '1)'.
Large elliptical orbit with arrowhead and a small planet dot appears around the pair of suns.
'1)' row: pair of suns with large ellipse orbit and planet dot; '2)' empty.
Label 'CIRCUMBINARY' appears under the ellipse.
'1)' diagram with label 'CIRCUMBINARY'; '2)' empty.

'1)' circumbinary diagram; single sun icon at '2)'.
Large elliptical orbit with arrow and a second small sun on it appears around the '2)' sun.
'2)' row: sun with large ellipse orbit carrying a second small sun.
Small inner orbit with arrow and a planet dot appears around the '2)' central sun.
Both diagrams: '1)' CIRCUMBINARY; '2)' sun with small inner planet orbit and large outer orbit of second sun.
Label 'THE OTHER KIND' appears under the '2)' diagram.
Both diagrams with labels 'CIRCUMBINARY' and 'THE OTHER KIND' (cropped near bottom edge).

Hard cut to pale blue sky with black hill silhouette at bottom, tiny stick figure left, bright white-glowing sun upper-left with dashed figure-eight path and arrowheads; bottom caption white 'THE OTHER KIND OF PLANET'.
Blue sky, one glowing sun with dashed loop path, tiny figure on hill, caption 'THE OTHER KIND OF PLANET'.
Second sun appears upper right with a dashed diagonal path and loop.
Two suns: left white glowing, right yellowish with halo and dashed loop path.
Label 'ORBITING THIS ONE' appears upper-left near the left sun.
Right sun now dim with faded halo; left sun bright; label 'ORBITING THIS ONE'. Onset of dimming UNRESOLVED (slow fade within hold).
Right sun reduced to a tiny white dot, halo gone.
Blue sky: bright left sun with label 'ORBITING THIS ONE'; right side tiny dot on dashed path.
Hard cut to tan desert scene: white caption 'TATOOINE, OUTER RIM TERRITORIES' upper-left, two white glowing suns, black silhouette with dome and tiny stick figure.
Tan desert scene with caption 'TATOOINE, OUTER RIM TERRITORIES', two suns, dome silhouette, stick figure.
White caption 'CIRCUMBINARY PLANET' appears bottom-centre.
Tan scene with both captions, two suns, figure.
Black double-headed dimension line with end ticks appears between the two suns.
Dimension line between the two suns; captions unchanged.
Small tick/bracket marks appear beside each sun end of the dimension line. Detail unreadable at tile scale.
Suns with dimension line and small end marks; captions; empty tan sky centre.
Cloud-shaped thought bubble fades in from translucent to opaque white at centre, tail toward figure; inside a small circle with dashed arrow and sun icons.
Opaque white thought bubble with small orbit diagram: circle with tiny sun, dashed arrow.
Bubble content changes to large orbit circle with sun at centre and small circle with sun and planet dot at lower right on orbit.
Bubble with big orbit circle, central sun, small circled sun at lower right.
Thought bubble fades to transparent and disappears; tan scene remains.
Tan scene: suns with dimension line, captions, no bubble.
Thought bubble fades in again with new content: circle orbit with two overlapping suns at centre and small planet dot on the orbit.
Opaque bubble: round orbit with arrow, twin suns at centre, planet dot.
Thought bubble fades out to nothing.
Tan scene, bubble gone and dimension line removed; two suns, captions, figure.

Small text appears upper-left: "*OF COURSE, RAINBOWS REQUIRE RAIN, WHICH MAKES THEIR APPEARANCE ON THE DESERT PLANET OF TATOOINE EVEN MORE SPECIAL"; faint rainbow arcs appear at right; stick figure raises arms.
Tan scene with footnote, faint rainbow arcs at right, figure with arms raised, caption 'CIRCUMBINARY PLANET'.
Hard cut to white whiteboard scene: stick figure at left, sun at left of board, tiny figure centre with dashed line, cone with '84°' label and coloured ring at right.
Whiteboard: sun, small figure, cone with '84°', rainbow ring; marker tray bottom.
Second sun appears lower-left with '30°' angle label and a second cone/ring overlapping the first; both cones labelled '84°'.
Board: two suns with '30°' angle, two overlapping cones labelled '84°'.
Second sun lower; label changes to '60°'; second cone and ring rotate upward.
Board: second sun at lower left with '60°', upper cone, right ring, both '84°'.
Second sun directly below figure, label '84°'; second ring lies flat horizontal above.
Board: sun left, second sun below with '84°', horizontal ring above, vertical ring right.
Board wiped; new diagram: two suns upper-left with dashed lines to a black dot at right and grey arc labelled '84°'.
Board: two suns, dashed lines, black dot, grey arc '84°'.
Concentric orbit circles with arrows appear around the suns and heading 'THE OTHER KIND OF PLANET' appears top.
Board with 'THE OTHER KIND OF PLANET' heading and nested orbit circles, '84°'.
Second small diagram right with heading 'CIRCUMBINARY PLANET': circle, two suns, dot, '84°'.
Two diagrams side by side with headings 'THE OTHER KIND OF PLANET' and 'CIRCUMBINARY PLANET'.

Both diagrams; red boxed 'IMPOSSIBLE' under right diagram.

Right diagram with short red arrow planet-to-sun, 'IMPOSSIBLE'.
Long curved red arrow appears from the planet down-left, ending at a small black dot outside the diagram.
Right diagram with red ejection arrow to a dot at lower left; 'IMPOSSIBLE' box.

Dark diagram with 'R CRITICAL ≈6d' label, central pair, orbit circle, '<-TATOOINE'.
Horizontal line from the star pair to Tatooine with label '<-6d->' and vertical 'd' dimension between the stars.
Dark diagram with '6d' line to Tatooine and 'd' marker between stars.
Wedge lines from Tatooine to each star and angle label '~18°' appear.
Dark diagram with wedge and '~18°' label, '6d', 'd', '<-TATOOINE'.

Dark 'LAGRANGE POINTS' diagram with L1-L5 labels, two stars.

Diagram with 'TATOOINE' at L4; layout otherwise as before.

Equilateral triangle with three '60°' labels; 'TATOOINE' at L4.

Tan scene with two suns, silhouettes, figure, two bright rainbow arcs at right.
Fainter secondary arcs appear outside the two bright arcs; bows overlap at right.
Tan scene with four overlapping arcs (two bright, two faint) at right; figure.
Two black pots (cauldron silhouettes) appear on the horizon at the arc feet.
Tan scene with two pots at the arc feet, four arcs, figure.
Pot count increases to four along the horizon, one at each arc foot; arcs slightly rearranged.
Four black pots on horizon below arcs, stick figure left, silhouettes.
